items.title: Geofences smaller than 100 m now work
items.description: Play Services and CoreLocation both need a radius of roughly 100 m — below that, a fence is smaller than the error of the fixes it is compared against and no crossing is ever reported. A sub-100 m circle, and any polygon, is now evaluated in-app against its true radius instead. Note the cost: such a fence needs the location stream running, which an OS-resolvable fence does not.

items.title: ENTER/EXIT no longer stop firing mid-session
items.description: Proximity registration rode the persistence-filtered location stream, so 3.8.0's transport-mode auto-tune could reject every fix and freeze it — after which no crossing was reported again. Geofences added with addGeofence() alongside continuous tracking also survive task removal and a reboot now.

items.title: notifyOnDwell and loiteringDelay are persisted
items.description: These columns existed but were never written or read, so every fence rebuilt from the database came back with DWELL off and a zero loitering delay — DWELL stopped working permanently after the first restore, and an explicit notifyOnExit: false was silently reverted.

items.title: Docs for older versions
items.description: The version dropdown next to the logo switches between the current docs and frozen archives of previous releases.
